title: FREE REQUEST Looking for Artist (Pixel art and Illustration/Character Design) - Genmetsu: Narrative RPG

posts.author: SutoriTheRat
posts.body:
Genmetsu is a narrative RPG developed in MZ.
The protagonists are four children aged 12-14
, a detail worth keeping in mind for those interested.
Spoiler:
Synopsis
Synopsis:
The story begins with a sealed demon accidentally released after a mysterious mirror is uncovered in the forest near the protagonists’ hometown. What starts as a local legend quickly escalates into a world-spanning conflict, as each character is forcibly separated and thrown into distant regions plagued by darkness.
Each area draws from unique cultural influences—steampunk, ancient Egypt, feudal Japan, and others—and presents new challenges, both physical and emotional. The central artifact,
Genmetsu
, is not just a magical object, but a narrative tool that breaks illusions, reveals hidden truths, and serves as a catalyst for each character’s personal growth.
The main cast must face not only external threats like elite shadow creatures and ruined cities, but also the internal weight of unresolved loss, identity, and memory. The narrative uses surreal dream sequences, symbolic environments, and memory-based events to explore each character’s past and development.
The game is structured across
seven chapters
, shifting gradually from light-hearted beginnings to heavier emotional and psychological territory. Themes of
grief, friendship, guilt, and resilience
are central, with character arcs that evolve through both gameplay and story integration.
Though still early in development, the project emphasizes
emotional storytelling, thematic consistency
, and
character-driven progression
, aiming to deliver a narrative that feels both intimate and expansive.
My role:
I’m the
writer
,
game designer
, and responsible for all in-game implementation using RPG Maker MZ
I'm currently looking for one or more artists to help me bring the world to life visually:
-
Pixel Artist
: For character sprites (
VS8 Sprite Sheet with diagonal movement
), poses, and possibly tileset adjustments.
-
Character Illustrator
: For in-game illustrations (sometimes there's an illustration in dialogue to better depict a scene), character design, and concept art.
Style:
I'm currently working with a
clean style
(no shadows or textures) for visual clarity, but I'm willing to
adapt to your preferred style
, as nothing is visually concrete yet.
The world is based on
different cultures
and designs:
-Medieval fantasy with contemporary twists.
-Ancient Egypt.
-Magical steam punk.
-Traditional Japanese culture.
-And a few others.
Current Progress
-
Story outline
. (Game divided into Episodes 1-7)
-
Sketches of the protagonists
+ certain
NPCs
and the
main villain
. (I'm open to any design suggestions)
-
Combat style sketches
+ some in-game implementations.
Collaboration Details
:
This is an
unpaid collaboration.
For now, my priority is to at least finish the first chapter to release a
DEMO
. Anyone willing will be fully credited and free to suggest their own ideas for design and more.
If you're interested, feel free to comment. Even if
visual art isn't your area of expertise
but you're willing to contribute in any other area, you're more than welcome.

posts.author: rhinosoup
posts.body: Hellooo! I’m an artist, and I’ve made my own game before. This project looks really interesting! I can help with sprite sheets, busts, character design and cutscenes. However, I’m not very good at story writing or coding. If you’d like to see more of my art, we can chat more on Discord or any other social media you prefer, or you can just visit my page for some of my in game art.
